note: Shared glossary for all Cantar de mio Cid texts. Old Spanish forms are glossed with their dictionary form (or modern Spanish equivalent) and a terse meaning; = introduces the modern Spanish spelling.

glossary.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por)
glossary.sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus)
glossary.tornava: tornar — he/she turned (imperfect); tornar = to turn, return
glossary.cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
glossary.i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
glossary.estávalos: estar + los — he-was + them: 'was … them' (estava + enclitic los)
glossary.catando: catar — looking at, beholding (gerund; archaic for mirar)
glossary.vío: veer — he saw (strong preterite of veer 'to see'; = vio, here two syllables ví-o)
glossary.abiertas: abierto — open (fem. pl.; past part. of abrir)
glossary.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
glossary.alcándaras: alcándara — perch, rack (for clothes or hunting birds; Arabic loan)
glossary.pielles: piel — fur, pelt, fur garment (pl. pielles = pieles)
glossary.mudados: mudado — moulted (of a hawk: having shed feathers in captivity, i.e. trained and valuable)
glossary.mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
glossary.çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
glossary.ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain)
glossary.avié: aver — he had (imperfect of aver = haber, here a full verb 'to have, hold')
glossary.fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
glossary.bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you')
glossary.mesurado: mesurado — measured, restrained, with mesura (courtly self-command)
glossary.grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had')
glossary.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight'
glossary.tí: tú — thee (stressed object pronoun; = ti, old accentuation)
glossary.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more')
glossary.en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak')
glossary.an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do'
glossary.buolto: bolver — stirred up, brewed, plotted (past part. of bolver = volver; bolver traición 'to weave treachery')
glossary.pienssan: pensar — they think; pensar de + inf. 'to set about (doing)' (epic formula)
glossary.aguijar: aguijar — to spur (one's horse), ride hard
glossary.las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
glossary.exida: exida — going out, departure (= salida; Latin exire)
glossary.bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
glossary.ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron)
glossary.diestra: diestro — right, on the right side (fem.)
glossary.burgos: Burgos — Burgos, chief city of Old Castile
glossary.siniestra: siniestro — left, on the left side (fem.; ill-omened)
glossary.meçió: meçer — he shook (preterite of meçer 'to shake'; = meció)
glossary.y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
glossary.engrameó: engramear — he tossed, shook (the head) — rare epic verb
glossary.tiesta: tiesta — head (cf. French tête; Latin testa)
glossary.albricia: albricia — good tidings! reward-for-good-news (Arabic al-bishāra); here a defiant cry
glossary.alvar: Alvar — Álvar (Fáñez), the Cid's kinsman and lieutenant ('Minaya')
glossary.echados: echar — cast out, thrown (past part. pl.); echados somos 'we are banished'
glossary.somos: seer — we are (1st pl. of seer = ser)
glossary.tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
glossary.roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
glossary.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid)
glossary.entróve: entrar — he entered (entró + archaic paragogic -e restored for the assonance)
glossary.pendones: pendón — pennon, lance-banner (men are counted by lances)
glossary.exien: exir — they went out (imperfect of exir 'to go out'; = salían)
glossary.lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative)
glossary.veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables)
glossary.plorando: plorar — weeping (gerund; older pl- form of llorar — the poem uses both)
glossary.dizían: dezir — they were saying (imperfect of dezir = decir)
glossary.qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of'
glossary.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!'
glossary.oviesse: aver — he had, he might have (imperfect subjunctive of aver; = hubiese)
glossary.conbidar: conbidar — to invite, take in as guest (= convidar)
glossary.ien: ien — they would (auxiliary of the split conditional: conbidar le ien = le convidarían; from avién)
glossary.don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift')
glossary.alfonsso: Alfonsso — Alfonso (VI, king of León and Castile)
glossary.avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié)
glossary.dél: de + él — from him, of him (contraction)
glossary.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand')
glossary.seellada: seellar — sealed (past part. fem.; seello < Latin sigillum, modern sello)
glossary.diessen: dar — they should give (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = diesen)
glossary.gela: ge + la — it to-him (ge = old dative 'to him/her', later se: modern se la)
glossary.diesse: dar — he should give (imperfect subjunctive; = diese)
glossary.sopiesse: saber — he should know (imperfect subjunctive of saber; = supiese)
glossary.vera: vero — true (fem.; vera palabra 'true word, sure truth')
glossary.averes: aver — goods, possessions, wealth (aver as noun, pl.)
glossary.más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more'
glossary.aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day')
glossary.yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
glossary.cristianas: cristiano — Christian (fem. pl.; las yentes cristianas = 'everyone')
glossary.ascóndense: asconder + se — they hide themselves (asconden + enclitic se; = esconderse)
glossary.nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
glossary.campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
glossary.adeliñó: adeliñar — he made straight for, headed to (preterite)
glossary.así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as'
glossary.puorta: puorta — door (older uo-diphthong spelling of puerta)
glossary.fallóla: fallar + la — he-found-it (falló + enclitic la; fallar = hallar, note f-)
glossary.pararan: parar — they had arranged, agreed (pluperfect in -ra; parar 'to arrange, settle')
glossary.quebrantás: quebrantar — he should break (apocopated imperfect subjunctive = quebrantasse)
glossary.abriessen: abrir — they should open (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = abriesen)
glossary.vozes: voz — voice (pl.; a altas vozes 'at the top of their voices')
glossary.querién: querer — they wished, would (imperfect 3rd pl.; = querían)
glossary.tornar: tornar — to return; tornar palabra 'to answer a word'
glossary.llegaua: llegar — he drew near (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of llegava)
glossary.ferídal: ferida + le — a blow to-it (ferida 'blow, stroke', = herida, note f-; + enclitic l(e))
glossary.era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser)
glossary.ojo: ojo — eye; a ojo 'in plain sight'
glossary.parava: parar — she placed, stationed (imperfect; se parava 'she stood forth')
glossary.ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already'
glossary.buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
glossary.çinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl. of çeñir; Latin cinxistis)
glossary.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has')
glossary.vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part)
glossary.osariemos: osar — we would dare (conditional 1st pl.; = osaríamos)
glossary.coger: coger — to take in, shelter (here = acoger) · also coger — to take up, strike (a tent: coger la tienda)
glossary.perderiemos: perder — we would lose (conditional 1st pl.; = perderíamos)
glossary.casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos')
glossary.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil')
glossary.ganades: ganar — you gain (2nd pl. present; = ganáis)
glossary.vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you')
glossary.vertudes: vertud — power, virtue (= virtud; sus vertudes santas 'his holy powers')
glossary.dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
glossary.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject)
glossary.vede: veer — he sees (older present vede, Latin videt; MS reads vee)
glossary.partiós: partir + se — he departed (partió + -s(e); partirse 'to take one's leave')
glossary.dela: de + la — from the (copyist's run-together spelling)
glossary.aguijaua: aguijar — he spurred (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of aguijava)
glossary.santa: santo — Saint (fem.); Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · santa — holy (adjective; santa Trinidad 'the Holy Trinity', santa María madre 'holy Mary, (thy) mother', the Virgin)
glossary.maría: María — Mary; Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos
glossary.fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
glossary.inojos: inojo — knee (= hinojo; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
glossary.fecha: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. of fazer = hacer; = hecha, note f-)
glossary.arlançón: Arlançón — the Arlanzón, the river of Burgos
glossary.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year')
glossary.çinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Latin cinxit)
glossary.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne)
glossary.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form)
glossary.l: le — to him (elided before vowel: l'an = le han)
glossary.conpra: conpra — buying, purchase (= compra) · also comprar — he/she buys (present 3rd sg.; = compra), as in non lo conpra, 'he does not buy it'
glossary.quantas: quanto — as many as (fem. pl.; = cuantas)
glossary.osarien: osar — they would dare (conditional 3rd pl.; = osarían)
glossary.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least'
glossary.dinarada: dinarada — a penny's-worth (what one dinero buys)
glossary.martín: Martín (Antolínez) — a knight of Burgos, companion of the Cid, who provisions him on his exile and negotiates the loan from Raquel and Vidas
glossary.antolínez: Antolínez — surname of Martín Antolínez, the Burgalese knight who aids the Cid
glossary.burgalés: burgalés — a man of Burgos (noun/adj.; el Burgalés, an epithet of Martín Antolínez)
glossary.conplido: conplido — complete, accomplished (past part. used as adj.; = cumplido, a term of praise)
glossary.abástales: abastar + les — he supplies them (abasta, present 3rd sg. of abastar 'to supply, provide', + enclitic les)
glossary.vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
glossary.todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
glossary.conducho: conducho — provisions, victuals (Latin conductus; covers everything an army eats)
glossary.ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished') · ovo de + inf., little more than a plain past (las manos se ovo de untar 'his hands were smeared'); dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight'
glossary.bastidos: bastir — furnished, equipped (past part. masc. pl., still agreeing with its object, los … bastidos)
glossary.pagós: pagar + se — he was pleased, was satisfied (pagó + -s(e): -se shrinks to -s after a stressed vowel; = pagóse)
glossary.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira')
glossary.odredes: oír — you will hear (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = oiréis; the minstrel's aside to his listeners)
glossary.dicho: dezir — said (past part.; a dicho = ha dicho, 'he has said')
glossary.canpeador: Campeador — spelling variant with n for m (copyist's spelling) of Campeador, the Cid's epithet
glossary.ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora)
glossary.fostes: seer — you were (archaic 2nd pl. preterite of ser, used respectfully to one person; = fuestes)
glossary.noch: noche — night (apocopated form of noche; cf. anoch)
glossary.yagamos: yazer — let us lie down, let us spend the night (present subjunctive/hortative 1st pl.; Latin iacere)
glossary.vayámosnos: ir + nos — let us go away (hortative vayamos + reflexive enclitic nos, the stem-final -s retained before the pronoun; = vayámonos)
glossary.matino: matino — morning (= la mañana; al matino 'in the morning')
glossary.seré: seer — I shall be (future 1st sg. of ser)
glossary.he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he)
glossary.ira: ira — wrath; en ira del rey = to be formally cast into the king's disgrace and exile, a legal idiom, not a mere figure of speech
glossary.alffons: Alfonso — Alfonso VI, king of Castile and León (copyist's shortened spelling, cf. alfons, alfonsso)
glossary.metido: meter — put, cast (past part.; seré metido = 'I shall be put/cast')
glossary.vusco: vusco — you (old fused form, con vusco = con vos, 'with you'; cf. convusco)
glossary.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?')
glossary.çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca)
glossary.querer: querer — to want, wish (infinitive; head of the split future querer m'a = me querrá, 'he will want me')
glossary.m: me — me, to me (elided form of me before a vowel, querer m'a = me querrá)
glossary.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as')
glossary.no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
glossary.preçio: preçiar — I value, prize (present 1st sg.; = aprecio)
glossary.un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
glossary.figo: figo — fig (= higo); non preçiar un figo, 'not to value at a fig', an idiom of contempt for something worthless
glossary.sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
glossary.lança: lança — lance (= lanza); ardida lança, 'bold lance', stands for the bold man who wields it
glossary.doblar: doblar — to double (infinitive; split future doblar vos he = os doblaré)
glossary.soldada: soldada — wages, pay (of a retained man; from sueldo)
glossary.espeso: espender — spent (past part.; = gastado; Latin expendere)
glossary.veedes: veer — you see (2nd pl. present, old -edes ending; = veis)
glossary.trayo: traer — I carry, bring (present 1st sg.; = traigo)
glossary.huebos: huebos — need (Latin opus); huebos (me) ser/aver = 'to have need (of)'
glossary.serié: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería)
glossary.compaña: conpaña — company, retinue (= compañía; spelling variant with m of conpaña)
glossary.fer: fazer — to do, make (short infinitive form; = hacer; fer lo he = lo haré, split future)
glossary.avrié: aver — there would be, he/it would have (conditional 3rd sg.; = habría)
glossary.bastir: bastir — to build, rig up, equip (the verb for Martín Antolínez's honest provisioning at v. 68, now used of the counterfeit chests)
glossary.inchámoslas: inchir + las — let us fill them (hortative inchamos + enclitic las; inchir = hinchir 'to fill', Latin implere)
glossary.d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another')
glossary.guadalmeçí: guadalmeçí — tooled, gilded leather of the costliest kind (Arabic loan, from Ghadāmes; cf. guadameçís)
glossary.enclaveadas: enclavear — studded, nailed (past part. fem. pl.; = enclavadas)
glossary.guadameçís: guadalmeçí — gilded leather (spelling variant without l, the same word as guadalmeçí)
glossary.vermejos: vermejo — bright red, crimson (masc. pl.; = bermejo)
glossary.raquel: Raquel — one of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos who take the pawned chests
glossary.vidas: Vidas — the other of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos, partner of Raquel
glossary.vayádesme: ir + me — go for me (vayades, 2nd pl. imperative/subjunctive of ir, old -ades ending, + enclitic me)
glossary.compra: conpra — buying, purchase (spelling variant with m of conpra)
glossary.ayrado: ayrar — angered, placed in disgrace (past part.; = airado; el rey me a ayrado, 'the king has turned his wrath on me', the legal condition of ira)
glossary.aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have')
glossary.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
glossary.enpeñar: enpeñar — to pledge, pawn (infinitive; = empeñar; split future enpeñar gelo he = se lo empeñaré)
glossary.gelo: ge + lo — it to him/them (ge, ancestor of modern se, + lo; = se lo)
glossary.fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
glossary.guisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable, right (past part. used as adj.)
glossary.lieven: llevar — let them carry (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = lleven)
glossary.cristianos: cristiano — Christian(s) (masc. pl.); moros nin cristianos / cristianos alone idiomatically = 'anyone at all'
glossary.véalo: veer + lo — may he (the Creator) see it (present subjunctive vea + enclitic lo)
glossary.santos: santo — saint (masc. pl.); los sos santos 'his saints' · also adjective, holy (los santos padres 'the holy fathers')
glossary.fago: fazer — I do, make (present 1st sg.; = hago)
glossary.detardava: detardar — was delaying (imperfect 3rd sg.; = tardaba, se retrasaba)
glossary.passó: passar — he passed, crossed (preterite 3rd sg.; = pasó)
glossary.castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos)
glossary.demandava: demandar — he was asking after, inquiring for (imperfect 3rd sg.)
glossary.uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró)
glossary.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado)
glossary.guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of'
glossary.menbrado: menbrado — prudent, shrewd (lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
glossary.caros: caro — dear, beloved (masc. pl.; not 'expensive' here)
glossary.poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence'
glossary.fablar: fablar — to speak (infinitive; = hablar, note f-)
glossary.querría: querer — I would like, would want (conditional 1st sg.)
glossary.detardan: detardar — they delay (present 3rd pl.; cf. detardava)
glossary.apartaron: apartar — they drew aside, withdrew (preterite 3rd pl., reflexive se apartaron)
glossary.manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding
glossary.descubrades: descubrir — you (may) reveal, betray (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = descubráis)
glossary.moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
glossary.siempre: siempre — always, forever; por siempre 'for ever'
glossary.faré: fazer — I shall make (future 1st sg.; = haré)
glossary.seades: seer — you may be (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = seáis)
glossary.menguados: menguado — diminished, in want, needy (past part./adj. pl.)
glossary.parias: paria — tribute paid by the Muslim taifa kingdoms to Castile (pl.)
glossary.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o])
glossary.entrado: entrar — entered, gone in (past part.; f[o] entrado = 'had gone in', a ser + participle periphrasis)

glossary.mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping'

glossary.veremos: veer — we shall see (future 1st pl.; = veremos)

glossary.rezaba: rezar — he was praying, reciting (imperfect 3rd sg.)
